## 4. Fixed canon and open space

The source message says: Bulletin 488-B. The Continuity Office rejects unsigned claims of discrepancy in grain tonnage circulated on unlicensed frequencies. Sector logs are reconciled weekly and available for inspection at the Continuity Office by appointment. Residents repeating unverified figures do so at their own standing. The Office will not debate its ledgers with static. The bank does not add a speaker identity, verify a disputed claim, invent a cause, or decode an unexplained instruction. Candidate language may add an image or sentence rhythm as an editorial draft, but no proposed addition becomes a confirmed transmission, event, identity, cause, or decoded instruction until an existing content owner selects and reviews it against the source.

## 5. Signal center

The voice at the center is Central Garrison Continuity Office. The Continuity Office’s defensive formality: numbered bulletin, appeal to procedure, and warning aimed at residents repeating disputed figures. Let listeners notice the pressure of the message without claiming every resident hears it in the same way.
